svg.title: Bruyère / 欧石楠 — historical heather group
svg.desc: A branching woody sprig representing the broad historical bruyère, or European heather group, rather than a single identified species. Many minute narrow evergreen leaves clothe the brown twigs; loose clusters of muted rose and lilac urn-shaped bells hang on short stalks, each with a contracted four-lobed mouth. Several dry, divided seed capsules remain on an older lateral twig. Fine umber and sage engraving is touched with translucent watercolor.
